selected_records.title: ADA 2025: A Multimodal Dataset for Water-Deficit Stress Detection in Sugar Beets

article.body:
**ADA 2025 dataset targets water-deficit stress in sugar beets**

The arXiv record describes ADA 2025 as a multimodal dataset for detecting water-deficit stress in sugar beets. The available information does not specify its modalities, collection procedure, detection method, evaluation data, baselines or metrics. Its measured performance and the conditions under which it was tested therefore cannot be established from this record. No conclusion about detection accuracy or field performance is supported.
